summary:
### Key Topics Discussed
- Layout and administration of objects, including viewing and editing an object and its associated metadata.
- Object identification details: 'family name', 'object name', unique system ID, and status.
- Improving user-friendliness by displaying selected metadata, including images, object location based on system info, and three customizable alphanumeric fields for metadata (e.g., object type, model, serial number, contact person, customer name, manufacturing year).
- Basic object logic: selecting and displaying parent objects with an option to connect additional parents, and managing subordinate (child) objects.
- Importance of keywords in the family name for efficient object searching.
- Risk of administrative errors when linking sub-objects due to lack of information.
- Similar layout and search logic for linking subordinate child objects, including metadata field search capability.
- Metadata organization into different areas (contact details, production details, geographical information) and user selection of displayed metadata due to screen limitations.
- Display of contact person information (title, creation date), handling multiple contacts, and updating/removing contact persons.
- Information about inherited contact data and its origin.
- Integration of address information, linked tasks, and order concepts, with system-generated metadata fields for the latter.
- Logging of images (date, time, user) and displaying their origin.
- Overview of object status, information, and upcoming tasks/events, including linked order concepts and tasks.
- Inclusion of metadata fields for fault reports.
- User interface management of screen size limitations by displaying limited groupings, requiring drill-down for more information.
- Final review of the improved and clarified layout by RepliK.

### Decisions Made
- The three alphanumeric fields in the header can be customized by the user to display various metadata, editable via the three-dot button.
- Existing object links can be deleted, and new ones added using the "Koppla objekt" (Link Object) button.
- A dedicated window will open for "Visa alla kontakter" (Show all contacts) to facilitate management, editing, and deletion of contacts.
- Changes to contact persons will be handled through this dedicated view.
- Information regarding contact data inheritance and its origin will be displayed alongside a log of who entered the data.
- RepliK is expected to update the current messy view in line with the new, clarified layout.

### Action Items
- The team needs to find a solution for selecting and displaying metadata fields due to screen space limitations.
- It must be clearly indicated whether a contact person (e.g., Anna Karlsson) is still active or if their information is outdated in the small contact display boxes.
- RepliK must update the view according to the new layout and raise any questions regarding it.

### Important Points & Insights
- The discussed image will be usable by all system users (administrators, planners, operators, customers).
- The goal is to administer objects and retrieve information about their status, as well as past and upcoming tasks and events.
- An example object, "Pantmaskin 2," belongs to a hierarchical structure (Axfood Sverige, Hemköpa, etc.).
- The object's unique system ID is system-generated and includes a running number.
- Object status is either `active` or `archived`.
- Five fields are available in the header for user-friendly display: two for images (vignette based on a metadata field), one for geographical location, and three alphanumeric fields for general, overarching information.
- The system will contain potentially hundreds of thousands of objects, demanding effective search functionality for object linking.
- Effective searching using keywords in the family name is essential to prevent administrative errors during object linking.
- The search functionality for linking child objects will have a similar layout and logic, allowing searches within metadata fields.
- The 'head' section primarily contains non-metadata information, with exceptions for the five display fields.
- Contact person details are categorized under contact metadata; Christer from service or an administrator would have entered this information.
- A small chain icon will indicate inherited contact information, showing its origin.
- It is important to log the date, time, and user for images.
- The interface aims to provide a comprehensive overview of status, information, and upcoming events/tasks.

### Open Questions/Pending Items
- The exact solution for metadata selection and display needs to be determined.
- How the user guide will address the navigation of metadata fields due to screen size limitations.
- RepliK's feedback on the refined layout.
